Contract ProcessSaleService::makeNewSale(): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(cd|cd.IsOpened = true)
	precondition:
		currentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		(CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = true)
	postcondition:
		let newSale: Sale in
		newSale.oclIsNew() and
		newSale.BelongedCashDesk = currentCashDesk and
		newSale.IsComplete = false and
		newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and
		Sale.allInstance()->includes(newSale) and
		result = true
}
